system.description:
There is nothing subtle about this power: where any vampire with Potence can exert tremendous pressure, you can crush steel in your bare hands and leave the mark of your grip behind.

For one Blood Trait you may crush steel and other tough materials with your bare hands, or leave lasting impressions of your grip in them for the rest of the scene — useful for intimidation or for climbing. Used against another vampire in an attack, Imprint inflicts one additional health level of lethal damage.
